stamp: {"keys":[{"id":"says-uncovered-what-site-covers","problem":"The page says the site has not yet researched or covered something that the site does cover on another of its pages: the currency exchange fee is listed here as something the site does not know yet, while the guide to a securities account explains the same fee and shows which houses charge it. A site that contradicts itself about what it knows makes the reader doubt both pages.","where":"the card for the currency exchange fee on the not-covered list, against the fee table row and the terms row about converting currency on the securities account guide (the last two screenshots)","kind":"general"},{"id":"bare-code","problem":"Where a card says what blocks it, some lines show only an internal code (letters and a number) instead of the question in words, so the reader cannot tell what is still open.","where":"the 'what blocks it' line of a few cards, beside the words 'open question' or 'set on'","kind":"general"},{"id":"fragment-no-noun","problem":"Lines under 'what was closed' read as fragments, a struck-out date followed by a bare number and a link, with no noun saying what the number counts or what was closed, so they mean nothing to a reader.","where":"the 'what was closed' lines of the open cards","kind":"general"},{"id":"source-names-not-for-reader","problem":"Some source lines name the source in English or as a copy (a wiki copy, a 'hosted copy', an English office name inside the Hebrew page) and still label it a primary source, which tells a reader neither who the source is nor whether to trust it.","where":"the source line under 'what is known' on a few cards","kind":"general"},{"id":"same-promise-every-card","problem":"Every open card ends with the same long promise of everything that will appear once it is closed (several pages and features named), the same words on each, more than the reader can believe will happen for each entry.","where":"the line starting 'when it is closed' at the bottom of each open card","kind":"general"}],"liked":[]}
